# Sillage Égypte — Extended Reference

Sillage Égypte is a private, luxury-tier tour operator designing bespoke journeys
across Egypt for discerning international travellers. All journeys are fully
private (no shared groups), led by certified Egyptologists and specialists, and
built around each traveller's interests, pace, and time. Primary markets: Europe,
North America, and Japan. Guiding languages: English, Arabic, French, Japanese.
Website: https://sillage-egypte.com — Contact: hello@sillage-egypte.com

## How we work

Every journey begins with a conversation, not a booking engine. A traveller
submits an enquiry; a journey designer replies within 24 hours and prepares a
private, no-obligation proposal, refined until it is exactly right. Pricing is
individual to each journey's length, accommodation standard, and included
experiences.

## Journeys

### The Private Nile — 7 days (Aswan to Luxor)
A private felucca with a dedicated crew and chef, mooring at temples before the
day boats arrive and at sandbanks no schedule would allow. Philae, Kom Ombo,
Edfu, Esna, and the Valley of the Kings, with an Egyptologist throughout.

### Desert & Oasis — 5 days (Western Desert)
The White Desert under stars and the untouched Siwa Oasis, with a private camp,
a Bedouin guide, Crystal Mountain, the Black Desert, the Oracle Temple, and the
salt lakes.

### Ancient Cairo & Luxor — 8 days
Giza before the crowds, the Grand Egyptian Museum, Islamic and Coptic Cairo,
then Karnak, the Valley of the Kings (including a tomb closed to general
visitors), Deir el-Medina, and Dendera.

### Nubia & the South — 6 days
Abu Simbel at sunrise, the rescued temples of Lake Nasser by private boat,
Philae, the unfinished obelisk, and living Nubian culture.

### Red Sea & Sinai — 6 days
A dawn ascent of Mount Sinai, St Catherine's Monastery, the Coloured Canyon,
and the quiet reefs of the southern Red Sea coast.

### The Complete Egypt — 14 days
The definitive journey: Giza and the museum, four nights on a private felucca,
two days in the Theban necropolis, and Abu Simbel at sunrise to close.

## Destinations

- Cairo — the pyramids, the Grand Egyptian Museum, the medieval city. Best Oct–Apr.
- Luxor — the Valley of the Kings, Karnak, Deir el-Bahari, Deir el-Medina. Best Oct–Apr.
- Aswan — Philae, granite islands, Nubian villages, gateway to the south. Best Oct–Apr.
- The Nile — sailed slowly by private felucca between Aswan and Luxor. Best Oct–Apr.
- The White Desert — chalk formations, dark skies, private desert camps. Best Oct–Mar.
- Siwa Oasis — the Oracle Temple, salt lakes, Berber culture. Best Oct–Apr.

## Experiences

Dawn at the Pyramids; A Balloon Over Luxor; Dinner With an Archaeologist; A
Temple After Dark; A Felucca at Sunset; A Night in the White Desert. Any of
these can be built into a journey.

## Guides

- Dr. Azmy Salama — Egyptologist, archaeologist and private guide; specialist in Saqqara, Memphis, Dahshur, Giza and the Old Kingdom.
- Sara Hassan — Cultural Historian & Desert Guide; MA Islamic Art & Architecture;
  Fatimid Cairo, Coptic heritage, oasis culture. Languages: English, Arabic,
  French, Japanese.
- Dr. Mostafa Ramzy — Egyptologist of the south; Nubian history, Abu Simbel, Lake
  Nasser. Languages: English, Arabic, Italian.
- Hany Abdel-Latif — Desert expedition guide; White Desert, Siwa, Sinai.
  Languages: English, Arabic.
- Farida Naguib — Cultural historian of Cairo; markets, architecture, modern city.
  Languages: English, Arabic, French.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: What does Sillage Égypte offer?
A: Fully private tours across Egypt — Nile journeys, desert and oasis
expeditions, and ancient-site immersion in Cairo and Luxor. Every tour is
designed exclusively for the traveller, with no shared groups.

Q: Who are the tours designed for?
A: International travellers (chiefly Europe, North America, Japan) who want
depth, expert knowledge, and total privacy.

Q: Are all tours private?
A: Yes. There are no shared group departures.

Q: How do I book?
A: Submit the Plan Your Journey form; a journey designer replies within 24 hours
to start a private proposal.

Q: What destinations are covered?
A: The Nile from Aswan to Cairo, the Valley of the Kings and Luxor, the White
Desert and Siwa, Islamic Cairo, and private access to sites off standard routes.

Q: How much does a private Egypt tour cost?
A: Pricing is individual to each journey. A clear, no-obligation proposal follows
an initial conversation. Sillage Égypte is a luxury-tier operator.
